text: [84] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi assaddho hoti ahiriko hoti anottappī 1 hoti kusīto hoti duppañño hoti imehi kho .pe. pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi saddho hoti hirīmā 2 hoti ottappī 3 hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti imehi kho .pe.
